game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats, erupting geyser flats: the lava scout must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ember crystals is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats: erupting geyser flats
core_gameplay_loop: In Geyser Flats, repeat each round: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ember crystals is fair. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the lava scout ahead. Then check the fair_trades value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the forge anvil by solving code steps involving fair_trades that move the lava scout forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the forge anvil first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Unit Trader
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Geyser Flats'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fair_trades changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Geyser Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
